Real-world fixtures, downloaded by scripts/fetch-fixtures.js (each under 1 MB).

three.js examples/models (MIT, https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js):
  dolphins.ply, dolphins_be.ply, dolphins_colored.ply, cube_gears.3mf (model CC BY-SA, Emmett Lalish),
  facecolors.3mf, vertexcolors.3mf (3MF Consortium samples), simple.pcd, pcl_logo.pcd, helix_201.xyz
Point Cloud Library test data (BSD-3-Clause, https://github.com/PointCloudLibrary/pcl): bunny.pcd
libigl tutorial data (https://github.com/libigl/libigl-tutorial-data): cube.off, decimated-knight.off
PyVista vtk-data (https://github.com/pyvista/vtk-data): fran_cut.vtk, polyEx.vtk
